title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED THIRTEEN HUNDRED AND TWENTY-ONE, ENTITLED "AN ACT ABOLISHING THE OFFICE OF FISCAL FOR THE PROVINCE OF ORIENTAL NEGROS AND PROVIDING THAT THE DUTIES OF FISCAL FOR THAT PROVINCE SHALL BE PERFORMED BY THE FISCAL OF THE PROVINCE OF CEBU.

text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered Thirteen hundred and twenty-one, entitled "An Act abolishing the
office of fiscal for the Province of Oriental Negros and providing that the duties of the fiscal for that
province shall be performed by the fiscal of the .Province of Cebu/' is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 2. The duties imposed by law upon the fiscal for the .Province of Oriental Negros shall hereafter be
performed by the fiscal of the Province of Cebu. In view of the additional duties hereby imposed upon the
fiscal of the Province of Cebu the salary of the fiscal of the two provinces shall be two thousand nine
hundred dollars, United States currency, per annum, of which one thousand- eight hundred dollars shall be
paid by the Province of Cebu and one thousand one hundred dollars by the Province of Oriental Negros, but
the fiscal shall appoint and shall pay for, out of his salary, a deputy fiscal for the Province of Oriental Negros
who shall not necessarily he subject to the provisions of the Civil Service Act, and who shall assist the fiscal
of Cebu in the performance of his official duties in the Province of Oriental Negros and also in the Province
of Cebu when his services are not required for the Province of Oriental Negros, and who shall reside at
Dumaguete, in the Province of Oriental Negros, or at Cebu, in the Province of Cebu, at the discretion of the
fiscal of Cebu. The fiscal of John is hereby authorized, when necessary, temporarily to detail from the office
of fiscal of the Province of Cebu one or more of the subordinate employees of said office for duty in the
Province of Oriental Negros. The necessary traveling expenses of the fiscal and subordinate employees of his
office in going to Dumaguete from Cebu and in returning to Cebu, and while traveling in the Province of
Oriental Negros in the performance of official duties pertaining to said province, shall he paid by the
Province of Oriental Negros. The necessary expenses of subsistence of the fiscal, the deputy fiscal for
Oriental Negros should his residence be fixed at Cebu, and other employees detailed for temporary duty in
Oriental Negros, while staying at Dumaguete, shall be considered subsistence expenses payable by the
Province of Oriental Negros: Provided, That the provisions of Act Numbered Thirteen hundred and thirty-
four shall be applicable in all cases. Should the deputy fiscal reside at Dumaguete the same rule shall apply

upon his temporary detail to Cebu, the expenses to be paid by the Province of Cebu, which province shall in
any event pay his traveling expenses between the provinces, irrespective of his place of residence. Upon the
recommendation of the provincial board of Oriental Negros and the approval of the Insular Treasurer said
fiscal is hereby authorized to appoint a clerk in the office of fiscal at Dumaguete whose salary shall be paid
from the funds of said Province of Oriental Negros."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws,"' passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, June 23, 1905.
